versos.grego: Καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὸ πέραν τῆς θαλάσσης εἰς τὴν χώραν τῶν Γερασηνῶν.

controles.web: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
controles.kjv: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
controles.livre: E chegaram ao outro lado do mar, à terra dos Gerasenos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξελθόντος αὐτοῦ ἐκ τοῦ πλοίου, εὐθὺς ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ ἐκ τῶν μνημείων ἄνθρωπος ἐν πνεύματι ἀκαθάρτῳ,

controles.web: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.
controles.kjv: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
controles.livre: Assim que Jesus saiu do barco, veio das sepulturas ao seu encontro um homem com um espírito imundo,

versos.grego: ὃς τὴν κατοίκησιν εἶχεν ἐν τοῖς μνήμασιν, καὶ οὐδὲ ἁλύσει οὐκέτι οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο αὐτὸν δῆσαι

controles.web: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,
controles.kjv: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
controles.livre: que morava nas sepulturas, e nem mesmo com correntes conseguiam mais prendê-lo;

versos.grego: διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν πολλάκις πέδαις καὶ ἁλύσεσιν δεδέσθαι, καὶ διεσπάσθαι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ τὰς ἁλύσεις καὶ τὰς πέδας συντετρῖφθαι, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἴσχυεν αὐτὸν δαμάσαι·

controles.web: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.
controles.kjv: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
controles.livre: pois muitas vezes fora preso com grilhões e correntes; mas as correntes eram por ele feitas em pedaços, os grilhões eram esmigalhados, e ninguém o conseguia controlar.

versos.grego: καὶ διὰ παντὸς νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ἐν τοῖς μνήμασιν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν ἦν κράζων καὶ κατακόπτων ἑαυτὸν λίθοις.

controles.web: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
controles.kjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
controles.livre: E sempre dia e noite andava gritando pelas sepulturas e pelos montes, e ferindo-se com pedras.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδὼν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἔδραμεν καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτόν,

controles.web: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,
controles.kjv: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
controles.livre: Quando ele viu Jesus de longe, correu e prostrou-se diante dele.

versos.grego: καὶ κράξας φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγει Τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί, Ἰησοῦ Υἱὲ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ Ὑψίστου; ὁρκίζω σε τὸν Θεόν, μή με βασανίσῃς.

controles.web: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”
controles.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
controles.livre: E gritou em alta voz: Que tenho eu contigo Jesus, Filho do Deus Altíssimo? Imploro-te por Deus que não me atormentes.

versos.grego: ἔλεγεν γὰρ αὐτῷ Ἔξελθε τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἀκάθαρτον ἐκ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

controles.web: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”
controles.kjv: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
controles.livre: (Pois Jesus havia lhe dito: “Sai deste homem, espírito imundo”.)

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν Τί ὄνομά σοι; καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Λεγιὼν ὄνομά μοι, ὅτι πολλοί ἐσμεν.

controles.web: He asked him, “What is your name?”   He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”
controles.kjv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
controles.livre: Então perguntou-lhe: Qual é o teu nome? E respondeu: Legião é o meu nome, porque somos muitos.

versos.grego: καὶ παρεκάλει αὐτὸν πολλὰ ἵνα μὴ αὐτὰ ἀποστείλῃ ἔξω τῆς χώρας.

controles.web: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
controles.kjv: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
controles.livre: E rogava-lhe muito que não os expulsasse daquela terra.

versos.grego: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ πρὸς τῷ ὄρει ἀγέλη χοίρων μεγάλη βοσκομένη·

controles.web: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.
controles.kjv: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
controles.livre: Havia ali perto do monte uma grande manada de porcos pastando.

versos.grego: καὶ παρεκάλεσαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Πέμψον ἡμᾶς εἰς τοὺς χοίρους, ἵνα εἰς αὐτοὺς εἰσέλθωμεν.

controles.web: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”
controles.kjv: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
controles.livre: E aqueles demônios  rogaram-lhe, dizendo: Manda-nos para aqueles porcos, para que entremos neles.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπέτρεψεν αὐτοῖς. καὶ ἐξελθόντα τὰ πνεύματα τὰ ἀκάθαρτα εἰσῆλθον εἰς τοὺς χοίρους, καὶ ὥρμησεν ἡ ἀγέλη κατὰ τοῦ κρημνοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, ὡς δισχίλιοι, καὶ ἐπνίγοντο ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ.

controles.web: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.
controles.kjv: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
controles.livre: Jesus lhes permitiu. Então aqueles espíritos imundos saíram para entrar nos porcos; e a manada lançou-se abaixo no mar; (eram quase dois mil) e afogaram-se no mar.

versos.grego: Καὶ οἱ βόσκοντες αὐτοὺς ἔφυγον καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ εἰς τοὺς ἀγρούς· καὶ ἦλθον ἰδεῖν τί ἐστιν τὸ γεγονός.

controles.web: Those who fed them fled, and told it in the city and in the country.   The people came to see what it was that had happened.
controles.kjv: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
controles.livre: Os que os apascentavam fugiram, e avisaram na cidade e nos campos; e as pessoas foram ver o que havia acontecido.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔρχονται πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν, καὶ θεωροῦσιν τὸν δαιμονιζόμενον καθήμενον ἱματισμένον καὶ σωφρονοῦντα, τὸν ἐσχηκότα τὸν λεγιῶνα, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν.

controles.web: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.
controles.kjv: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
controles.livre: Então aproximaram-se de Jesus, e viram o endemoninhado sentado, vestido, e em sã consciência o que tivera a legião; e ficaram apavorados.

versos.grego: καὶ διηγήσαντο αὐτοῖς οἱ ἰδόντες πῶς ἐγένετο τῷ δαιμονιζομένῳ καὶ περὶ τῶν χοίρων.

controles.web: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
controles.kjv: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
controles.livre: E os que haviam visto contaram-lhes o que acontecera ao endemoninhado, e sobre os porcos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἤρξαντο παρακαλεῖν αὐτὸν ἀπελθεῖν ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν.

controles.web: They began to beg him to depart from their region.
controles.kjv: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
controles.livre: Então começaram a rogar-lhe que saísse do território deles.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐμβαίνοντος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πλοῖον παρεκάλει αὐτὸν ὁ δαιμονισθεὶς ἵνα μετ’ αὐτοῦ ᾖ.

controles.web: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
controles.kjv: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
controles.livre: Quando Jesus entrava no barco, o que fora endemoninhado rogou-lhe que estivesse com ele.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἀφῆκεν αὐτόν, ἀλλὰ λέγει αὐτῷ Ὕπαγε εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου πρὸς τοὺς σούς, καὶ ἀπάγγειλον αὐτοῖς ὅσα ὁ Κύριός σοι πεποίηκεν καὶ ἠλέησέν σε.

controles.web: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you, and how he had mercy on you.”
controles.kjv: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
controles.livre: Jesus  se recusou, porém lhe disse: Vai para a tua casa, aos teus, e anuncia-lhes quão grandes coisas o Senhor fez contigo, e como teve misericórdia de ti.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν καὶ ἤρξατο κηρύσσειν ἐν τῇ Δεκαπόλει ὅσα ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ πάντες ἐθαύμαζον.

controles.web: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
controles.kjv: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
controles.livre: Então ele foi embora, e começou a anunciar em Decápolis quão grandes coisas Jesus havia feito com ele; e todos se admiravam.

versos.grego: Καὶ διαπεράσαντος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ πάλιν εἰς τὸ πέραν συνήχθη ὄχλος πολὺς ἐπ’ αὐτόν, καὶ ἦν παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν.

controles.web: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.
controles.kjv: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
controles.livre: Depois de Jesus passar outra vez num barco para o outro lado, uma grande multidão se ajuntou a ele; e ele ficou junto ao mar.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔρχεται εἷς τῶν ἀρχισυναγώγων, ὀνόματι Ἰάειρος, καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὸν πίπτει πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet,
controles.kjv: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
controles.livre: E veio um dos líderes de sinagoga, por nome Jairo; e quando o viu, prostrou-se aos seus pés.

versos.grego: καὶ παρακαλεῖ αὐτὸν πολλὰ λέγων ὅτι Τὸ θυγάτριόν μου ἐσχάτως ἔχει, ἵνα ἐλθὼν ἐπιθῇς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῇ, ἵνα σωθῇ καὶ ζήσῃ.

controles.web: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”
controles.kjv: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
controles.livre: E implorava-lhe muito, dizendo: Minha filhinha está a ponto de morrer. Rogo-te que venhas pôr as mãos sobre ela, para que seja curada, e viva.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν μετ’ αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς, καὶ συνέθλιβον αὐτόν.

controles.web: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.
controles.kjv: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
controles.livre: Jesus foi com ele. Uma grande multidão o seguia, e o apertavam.

versos.grego: Καὶ γυνὴ οὖσα ἐν ῥύσει αἵματος δώδεκα ἔτη,

controles.web: A certain woman, who had an issue of blood for twelve years,
controles.kjv: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
controles.livre: E havia uma mulher, que tinha um fluxo de sangue havia doze anos,

versos.grego: καὶ πολλὰ παθοῦσα ὑπὸ πολλῶν ἰατρῶν καὶ δαπανήσασα τὰ παρ’ αὐτῆς πάντα, καὶ μηδὲν ὠφεληθεῖσα ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον εἰς τὸ χεῖρον ἐλθοῦσα,

controles.web: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,
controles.kjv: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
controles.livre: que tinha sofrido muito por meio de muitos médicos, e gastado tudo quanto possuía, e nada havia lhe dado bom resultado; ao invés disso, piorava.

versos.grego: ἀκούσασα τὰ περὶ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ἐλθοῦσα ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ ὄπισθεν ἥψατο τοῦ ἱματίου αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd, and touched his clothes.
controles.kjv: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
controles.livre: Quando ela ouviu falar de Jesus, veio entre a multidão por detrás, e tocou a roupa dele.

versos.grego: ἔλεγεν γὰρ ὅτι Ἐὰν ἅψωμαι κἂν τῶν ἱματίων αὐτοῦ σωθήσομαι.

controles.web: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”
controles.kjv: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
controles.livre: Pois dizia: Se tão somente tocar as suas roupas, serei curada.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐξηράνθη ἡ πηγὴ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς, καὶ ἔγνω τῷ σώματι ὅτι ἴαται ἀπὸ τῆς μάστιγος.

controles.web: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
controles.kjv: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
controles.livre: E imediatamente a fonte do seu sangue parou se secou; e sentiu no corpo que já havia sido curada daquele flagelo.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐπιγνοὺς ἐν ἑαυτῷ τὴν ἐξ αὐτοῦ δύναμιν ἐξελθοῦσαν, ἐπιστραφεὶς ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ ἔλεγεν Τίς μου ἥψατο τῶν ἱματίων;

controles.web: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd, and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
controles.kjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
controles.livre: Jesus logo notou em si o poder que dele havia saído. Então virou-se na multidão, e perguntou: Quem tocou as minhas roupas?

versos.grego: καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ Βλέπεις τὸν ὄχλον συνθλίβοντά σε, καὶ λέγεις Τίς μου ἥψατο;

controles.web: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
controles.kjv: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
controles.livre: E seus discípulos lhe disseram: Eis que a multidão te aperta, e perguntas: Quem me tocou?

versos.grego: καὶ περιεβλέπετο ἰδεῖν τὴν τοῦτο ποιήσασαν.

controles.web: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.
controles.kjv: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
controles.livre: E ele olhava em redor, para ver quem havia lhe feito isso.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ γυνὴ φοβηθεῖσα καὶ τρέμουσα, εἰδυῖα ὃ γέγονεν αὐτῇ, ἦλθεν καὶ προσέπεσεν αὐτῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ πᾶσαν τὴν ἀλήθειαν.

controles.web: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
controles.kjv: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
controles.livre: Então a mulher temendo, e tremendo, sabendo o que lhe havia sido feito , veio, prostrou-se diante dele, e disse-lhe toda a verdade.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Θυγάτηρ, ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε· ὕπαγε εἰς εἰρήνην, καὶ ἴσθι ὑγιὴς ἀπὸ τῆς μάστιγός σου.

controles.web: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
controles.livre: E ele lhe disse: Filha, a tua fé te salvou. Vai em paz, e estejas curada deste teu flagelo.

versos.grego: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἔρχονται ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀρχισυναγώγου λέγοντες ὅτι Ἡ θυγάτηρ σου ἀπέθανεν· τί ἔτι σκύλλεις τὸν διδάσκαλον;

controles.web: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”
controles.kjv: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
controles.livre: Estando ele ainda falando, alguns vieram da casa do líder de sinagoga, e disseram: A tua filha já morreu; por que ainda estás incomodando o Mestre?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς παρακούσας τὸν λόγον λαλούμενον λέγει τῷ ἀρχισυναγώγῳ Μὴ φοβοῦ, μόνον πίστευε.

controles.web: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”
controles.kjv: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus, não dando atenção a essa palavra que havia sido falada, disse ao líder de sinagoga: Não temas; crê somente.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἀφῆκεν οὐδένα μετ’ αὐτοῦ συνακολουθῆσαι εἰ μὴ τὸν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰάκωβον καὶ Ἰωάνην τὸν ἀδελφὸν Ἰακώβου.

controles.web: He allowed no one to follow him, except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
controles.kjv: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
controles.livre: E não permitiu que ninguém o seguisse, a não ser Pedro, Tiago, e João irmão de Tiago.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ ἀρχισυναγώγου, καὶ θεωρεῖ θόρυβον, καὶ κλαίοντας καὶ ἀλαλάζοντας πολλά,

controles.web: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.
controles.kjv: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
controles.livre: Eles chegaram à casa do líder de sinagoga, e Jesus viu o alvoroço, os que choravam muito e pranteavam.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰσελθὼν λέγει αὐτοῖς Τί θορυβεῖσθε καὶ κλαίετε; τὸ παιδίον οὐκ ἀπέθανεν ἀλλὰ καθεύδει.

controles.web: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”
controles.kjv: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
controles.livre: E ao entrar, disse-lhes: Por que fazeis alvoroço e chorais? A menina não morreu, mas está dormindo.

versos.grego: καὶ κατεγέλων αὐτοῦ. αὐτὸς δὲ ἐκβαλὼν πάντας παραλαμβάνει τὸν πατέρα τοῦ παιδίου καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ τοὺς μετ’ αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἰσπορεύεται ὅπου ἦν τὸ παιδίον.

controles.web: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.
controles.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
controles.livre: E riram dele. Porém ele, depois de pôr todos fora, tomou consigo o pai e a mãe da menina, e os que estavam com ele. Em seguida, entrou onde a menina estava .

versos.grego: καὶ κρατήσας τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ παιδίου λέγει αὐτῇ Ταλιθὰ κούμ, ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Τὸ κοράσιον, σοὶ λέγω, ἔγειρε.

controles.web: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!”  which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”
controles.kjv: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
controles.livre: Ele pegou a mão da menina, e lhe disse: “Talita cumi”, (que significa: “Menina, eu te digo, levanta-te”).

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνέστη τὸ κοράσιον καὶ περιεπάτει· ἦν γὰρ ἐτῶν δώδεκα. καὶ ἐξέστησαν εὐθὺς ἐκστάσει μεγάλῃ.

controles.web: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.
controles.kjv: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
controles.livre: E logo a menina se levantou e andou, pois já tinha doze anos de idade. E logo ficaram grandemente espantados.

versos.grego: καὶ διεστείλατο αὐτοῖς πολλὰ ἵνα μηδεὶς γνοῖ τοῦτο, καὶ εἶπεν δοθῆναι αὐτῇ φαγεῖν.

controles.web: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
controles.kjv: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
controles.livre: E mandou-lhes muito que ninguém o soubesse; e mandou que dessem a ela de comer.
